name: orion-admin-framework-tests
description: Integration tests: Orion Admin inside React 18, React 19, Vue 3 and Angular (run from this folder: npm install && npm test)

scripts.test: node build.mjs && cd ../.. && node build/check.mjs tests/frameworks/out/react19.html tests/frameworks/out/react18.html tests/frameworks/out/vue.html tests/frameworks/out/angular.html --warn --wait=1500 --eval=window.runTest()
